title: Restore a mechanical pencil whose broken lead blocks the feed
instruction: Make the mechanical pencil ready to write again.
justification: Pentel provides exact PG1019 jam-clearing instructions; the manufacturer markets this current pencil for ordinary writing. Precise prevalence of jam-clearing is not measured.
fault: Short broken graphite fragment in the guide/inner tip prevents native lead feed. Fault geometry must be demonstrated, not a software flag.
objects: Full-size Pentel Graphgear1000 PG1019 reconstruction with retractable4mm sleeve, nominal0.9mm lead, original threaded cone/inner tip, three-jaw chuck, retainer and clip latch
Ordinary0.9mm clearing wire held in a commercial pin vise
Fresh matching lead and ordinary desk supports/distractors
skill: Selective small-part disassembly, clearing a physical passage and restoring the functioning feed/retention/retraction mechanism. Any harmless shortcut remains valid.
scoring: Unimplemented pending full physical mechanism; no assembly-only proxy or scripted release.
risks: Exact local dimensions and forces require disclosed source-informed reconstruction, not OEM calibration claims
Retainer compliance and actual fragment jam may be difficult to represent at native scale
Long physical thread disassembly/reassembly can exceed a default action budget
A successful pin push alone is not the whole recovery or a novel task

sources.supports: Exact family includesPG1019. Outer cone unscrews first, then inner metal tip; blocked sleeve is cleared from its front with a matching lead. Chuck debris can be removed with fingers or matching lead. Refit both threaded parts and check feed with eraser cap installed.
sources.does_not_support: Exact thread pitch, hidden chuck dimensions, spring rates or fault frequency.

sources.supports: Same Graphgear family procedure; gauge-matched crafting wire is an expressly permitted alternative to a fresh lead.
Nominal0.9mm,4mm retractable sleeve, metal/rubber grip, ordinary writing as well as drafting.
Rear knock extends the writing end; opening the clip retracts it.
Industry explanation of ordinary chuck/ring, lead retainer, return spring and incremental lead feed. This supports general feed topology, not an OEMPG1019 drawing.
Broken short lead can jam guide pipe or three-way chuck; removal with replacement lead is routine troubleshooting. Excessive force can damage chuck; bent/crushed guide pipes require replacement.
Ordinary commercial pin vises hold small wire; full-length handle bore permits long stock. A0–1mm162A can hold the0.9mm clearing wire without a guided insertion fixture.

status: held: source-corrected feed core expelled free graphite through inferred housing/guide region; no healthy baseline
